strings.app.title: Worksheet
strings.sheet.instruction.write-own: Look at the picture and write about it.
strings.fit.fits: Fits on one page — {words} words, level {level}.
strings.fit.extends: Longer than one page — this worksheet will print on {pages} pages ({words} words, level {level}). For one page, try: {suggestions}.
strings.fit.blocked: Cannot lay out this worksheet ({code}): {reason}. Try: {suggestions}.
strings.fit.blocked.reason.WIDTH_OVERFLOW: a word is wider than the page
strings.fit.blocked.reason.BLOCK_TOO_TALL: the image, header, or handwriting lines are taller than a page
strings.fit.blocked.reason.TOO_FEW_SENTENCES: this text has too few sentences to put in order (at least 3)
strings.export.failed: Export failed: {message}. See browser console for details.
strings.fit.internalError: The worksheet could not be prepared: {message}. Printing is disabled. See browser console for details.
strings.notice.GRAY_COLLISION: In black-and-white print, some marking colors come out almost the same gray. Letters and syllables stay readable, but the color no longer tells them apart.
strings.notice.DOCX_OMITS_STRIPES: The Word file doesn't have the alternate-line stripes (they are in the print only).
strings.notice.DOCX_OMITS_ARCS: The Word file doesn't have the syllable arcs (they are in the print only).
strings.notice.ARCS_NEED_LINE_SPACING: Syllable arcs need more room between lines: set the line spacing to at least 1.6.
strings.notice.NO_SYLLABLE_DATA: This text has no syllable data, so syllable colors, separators and arcs do nothing for it.
strings.copyTarget.title: Title only
strings.copyTarget.hint: Click the sentence to copy in the preview.
strings.notice.COPY_TARGET_UNCHOSEN: Choose the sentence to copy: click it in the preview.
strings.notice.COPY_SPACE_SHORT: About {needed} lines are needed to copy this; the sheet has {rows} (an estimate). Choose less to copy, or plan a second sheet of lines.
strings.notice.DOCX_OMITS_COPY_MARK: The Word file doesn't mark what to copy (the mark is in the print only). Turn on “One sentence per line” to have it in Word too.
strings.writingMode.sequenceTooFew: Put in order (too few sentences in this text: {count})
strings.sheet.instruction.sequence: Number the sentences in the right order.
strings.cloze.hint: Click words in the preview to turn them into gaps (or use the arrow keys and Space).
strings.cloze.tooMany: At most {max} gaps for this text.
strings.notice.SELECTION_RESET: The text changed, so the gaps chosen for it were removed.
strings.notice.NO_GAPS: No gaps yet: click words in the preview, or use “Gap every Nth word”.
strings.preview.empty: Choose a theme and level, then click "Create text".
strings.graphemes.invalid: “{group}” is not a letter group: type 1–4 letters, separated by commas. Nothing was changed.
strings.graphemes.tooMany: At most {max} letter groups. Nothing was changed.
strings.preset.saveFailed: Saving failed. Settings are only available for this session.
strings.preset.storageUnavailable: Saving isn't available in this browser — built-in setups still work.
strings.preset.invalid: This setup can't be used — it looks corrupted or was saved by a different app version.
strings.image.error.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: Image must be PNG or JPEG.
strings.image.error.DECODE_FAILED: Couldn't open the file as an image.
strings.error.INVALID_JSON: The selected file is not valid JSON.
strings.packet.empty: No sheets in the packet yet.
strings.setup.import.error.UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA: This file isn't a supported setups backup.
strings.setup.import.error.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Couldn't save — storage isn't available in this browser.
strings.reset.confirm: Delete all saved setups on this computer? This can't be undone.
strings.export.formatNote: Print / PDF keeps the layout exactly as previewed. Word (.docx) is editable and may reflow slightly in your word processor.
